evidence.quote: I am interested in Riverview State University because its project-based curriculum would let me connect Theatre, Political Science, Business with questions that matter outside a single classroom.
I hope to learn from students with different experiences, use faculty feedback to improve my work, and contribute to teams that value both evidence and clear communication.
Through varsity soccer player, I learned to notice which tasks are preventing a group from moving forward.
I would bring that practical habit to campus organizations: listen first, clarify the goal, volunteer for concrete work, and help the group document what it learns.
A question I want to explore is how tools and methods from Theatre, Political Science, Business can be applied responsibly when information is incomplete.
I am especially interested in courses that combine analysis, writing, and collaborative problem solving.
